principles: A course-version ID describes verified route geometry evidence, not merely a marketing distance label.
Years share one course-version only when the same organizer source or exact public-geometry fingerprint supports identity.
Near-identical but non-identical geometries use separate course versions and may share a whole_course_comparison_group when corridor analysis supports compatibility.
A verified course-version assignment does not imply that a redistributable/local route asset exists for frontend maps or replay.
Duo inherits the Ultra 60 full-course version for the same year; its relay exchange is modelled separately.

A source-year mismatch blocks direct year assignment unless independent year-specific evidence triangulates the candidate against race-day distance/elevation/landmarks or other documented controls; any stale source metadata must remain visible in provenance.
